We engaged three human reviewers to find web articles that precisely match the answers to the time-sensitive questions.
guideline: Reviewers answered the same time-sensitive questions to establish a baseline accuracy.
Human reviewers judged the correctness of the model answers on a sampled subset of questions.

Each reviewer was assigned a total of 150 questions. These questions were equally distributed across three distinct datasets: TimeQA, TempReason, and MenatQA. Each reviewer conducted a direct search of the question on the web using standard Google searches. The task was to browse and review up to a maximum of five articles per question.
